name: The Iron-Thorn Warren
modifiers: All enemies inflict +2 bleed damage per second on melee hit
Fire damage dealt by party members is increased by 25%
Healing potions restore 30% less health inside the warren
intro: Blood-soaked bramble tunnels wind beneath the Sunken Ford, where parasitic iron-thorns pulse like veins through rotting oak roots.

name: Drowned Lantern Undercroft
modifiers: Thick marsh-gas reduces ranged attack accuracy by 20%
Enemies release a small poison cloud on death
intro: Emerald corpse-lights drift across knee-deep black water in this flooded border vault, luring iron-shod boots toward hidden sinkholes.

name: The Calcified Quarry
modifiers: All enemies gain +4 physical armor
Lightning damage ignores 50% of enemy armor
Movement speed is reduced by 15% in loose gravel
intro: Shattered grey chert slabs tower over an abandoned stone-pit where calcified beasts grind their dorsal plates against iron ore.

name: Ashen Totem Hollow
modifiers: Non-boss enemies revive once at 35% HP unless burned
Cold spells gain +20% critical strike chance
intro: Smoking bone-totems ring a sunken clearing above Lantern Passage, rekindling fallen raiders with bitter charcoal magic.

name: The Mist-Choked Thicket
modifiers: Shadow-mist silences casters for 2 seconds when struck
Party dodge chance is increased by 15%
Enemy movement speed is increased by 20%
intro: Ribbons of narcotic grey fog hang motionless between gnarled oaks, muffling bowstrings while spectral antlers gleam in the dark.

name: The Ossuary Loom
modifiers: Brood-cocoons hatch spiderlings every 25 seconds
Poison resistance is reduced by 25% for all units
Fire area spells ignite floor webbing for bonus damage
intro: Cathedral arches of woven femurs and sticky grey silk span the deepest crypt beneath Ravenwatch, vibrating with each footstep.

name: The Singing Salt-Pan
modifiers: Static storms deal periodic lightning damage every 15 seconds
Lightning resistance is increased by 30% for enemies
Physical attacks discharge small static arcs on hit
intro: Blinding white salt-crusts crackle beneath dry wind, turning every iron helm and spear-tip into a humming lightning rod.

name: Red-Grit Ambush Gorge
modifiers: Haboob dust reduces vision and range by 2 tiles
Enemies gain +25% attack speed below 50% HP
intro: Howling red grit scours a narrow sandstone slot where desert cutthroats strike from blind corners and vanish into dust.

name: The Venomous Basin
modifiers: Poison ticks 50% faster on all units
Cold damage slows enemies by an additional 20%
Water flasks and healing draughts have +5s cooldown
intro: Cracked limestone cisterns overflow with brackish venom where hooded serpents rattle bone-blades across sun-baked stone.

name: The Bile-Weeping Ring
modifiers: Hex circles reduce party armor by 3 while standing inside
Physical melee damage is increased by 20%
intro: Twelve black megaliths sweat green miasma into a stagnant willow sink while smoking skull-censers swing through the reeds.

name: The Shovel-Claw Gallery
modifiers: Earthquakes stun random units for 1 second every 20 seconds
Burrowing enemies emerge with a 2-tile knockback
Fire damage is increased by 20% in stale tunnel air
intro: Groaning basalt pillars prop up a flooded quarry shaft where eyeless bone-diggers erupt without warning beneath iron boots.

name: The Sunken Obelisk Pit
modifiers: Unnatural frost aura slows stamina recovery by 25%
Pull effects draw units 1 tile closer toward the center
Fire spells deal +30% damage to chilled foes
intro: Toppled golden obelisks jut from a freezing sand-crater at the heart of Redmarsh, radiating a hollow, subterranean hunger.

name: The Low-Tide Hulks
modifiers: Standing water conducts lightning to adjacent allies
Enemy frontal armor is increased by 30%
intro: Broken merchant cogs tilt in sucking grey silt while towering brine-armored crustaceans clash their shield-claws in the surf.

name: The Boiling Fumaroles
modifiers: Volcanic vents erupt for fire damage every 12 seconds
Cold spells cool ground hazards and deal +25% damage
Bleeding wounds cauterize instantly but deal burst fire damage
intro: Scalding steam hisses through razor-edged sheets of black volcanic glass where slag-armed homunculi hurl molten rock.

name: The Void-Eye Crag
modifiers: Mana regeneration is reduced by 40%
Ranged physical attacks deal +25% damage
Enemies drain 8 mana per hit on unshielded targets
intro: Howling sea-gales whip around a razor-backed granite spire where giant nocturnal moths drink spell-light straight from minds.

name: The Drowned Chime-Nave
modifiers: Sonic bell-tolls add +4 seconds to active spell cooldowns
Blunt physical attacks shatter frozen barriers for bonus damage
intro: Half-submerged chapel arches ring with teeth-vibrating bronze harmonics as frost-chained bells drift above black Atlantic swells.

name: The Sea-Cellar Throne
modifiers: Enemies are immune to fear and slow effects
Fire damage melts enemy armor by 1 per hit
Party critical strike damage is increased by 25%
intro: Brine drips through rusted vault grates onto stacked bullion chests where an iron-crowned specter still exacts bloody taxes.

name: The Sunken Antiphon
modifiers: Liturgical waves alternate between cold and lightning damage
Interrupted enemy casts grant the party +15% haste for 6s
Healing effectiveness is reduced by 20%
intro: Towering pipes of hollowed human bone rise above flooded pews, channeling drowning tides into deafening spectral chords.

name: The Obsidian Razor-Ridge
modifiers: Burning glass patches inflict bleed and fire damage when crossed
Cold magic deals +30% damage to airborne foes
intro: Jagged sheets of crimson volcanic glass jut from choking ash-drifts where lesser drakes bank through sulfurous thermals.

name: The Grounding-Chain Spire
modifiers: Melee attacks against rooted enemies trigger chain lightning
Poison damage bypasses 40% of enemy resistances
Units standing within 2 tiles of each other share 15% shock damage
intro: Lightning-cleft highland pines hum with ten thousand volts above West Crag, anchored to obsidian stone by white-hot chains.

name: The Hexagonal Breach
modifiers: All enemies gain +35% knockback resistance and +20% melee damage
Cold spells reduce enemy attack speed by 30%
intro: Cracked basalt ramparts tremble under the tread of walking volcanic pillars whose magma-veined arms shatter shield-walls.

name: The Shrapnel Foundry
modifiers: Molten shrapnel erupts whenever an enemy uses a special ability
Armor is reduced by 3 for all units in extreme forge heat
Cold and astral attacks deal +20% bonus damage
intro: White-hot slag spits from floor fissures beside chained iron anvils where chimney-backed siege titans hammer living steel.

name: The Lodestone Gauntlet
modifiers: Heavy armor slows movement speed by an additional 20%
Ranged projectiles veer randomly unless targets are marked
Astral spells ignore all armor and magnetic deflection
intro: Raw magnetic ore walls tug steel scabbards sideways along a spiked defile patrolled by black-iron citadel executioners.

name: The Crucible of Ashkarath
modifiers: Rings of hellfire sweep the arena every 18 seconds
Bone prisons spawn around isolated backline units
All party damage is increased by 20% while above 75% HP
intro: Fused iron swords blaze like a white-hot halo above an obsidian dais suspended over the roaring heart of the caldera.
